## agentckpt v0.3.0: safer snapshots

Snapshots now store exactly what's on disk, restore never leaves a half-applied tree, and you control what goes in.

### New

- **`.agentckptignore`**: keep paths out of snapshots (same syntax as `.gitignore`) without touching your `.gitignore`, index or `git status`. `restore` never deletes excluded paths. ([#11](https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt/pull/11))
- **Gitignored state** ([#4](https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt/issues/4)): each snap records a metadata-only manifest of gitignored files, and `restore` warns when they changed or went missing. Opt in to capturing named paths with `include_ignored`; secret-looking files (`.env*`, `*.pem`, …) also need `allow_secrets = true` and are stored unencrypted.

### Fixes

- Files over `--max-bytes` are skipped before `git add`, so they never grow the store ([#2](https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt/issues/2)).
- Symlinks are restored as symlinks; restore is all-or-nothing, so an error leaves the tree unchanged ([#6](https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt/issues/6)).
- Snapshots keep exact bytes: no `core.autocrlf`, `eol` or git-lfs conversion, so Windows no longer reports untouched files as conflicts. `--path .github` keeps its leading dot ([#8](https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt/issues/8)).

### Docs

- First-screen FAQ: store size, `.gitignore`, ignored `.env`.

### Install

```bash
pipx install https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt/releases/download/v0.3.0/agentckpt-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)
